about: The sales close of every lottery draw, per game and weekday, as Brussels wall time (src/Liveness.py close_instant turns it into an instant, DST included; draws.js and rankhistory.js read the same file). A ticket saved after its draw's close could not have been played: the report counts it out of the live record (Helpers.generate_model_performance_report, 27 Oct 2026).
source: The National Lottery's draw API (natlot): a draw's drawTime is its sales close - closeTime equals drawTime and wagers stop 1 second before it (wagerCloseTime = drawTime - 1 s); the results follow 17-100 minutes later.

overAYear.result: every draw on its weekday's time below (re-checked 27 Oct 2026)

sixWeeksOnly.result: every draw on its weekday's time below; the API answered a longer range for these three with an HTML page, so check them again over a year when it answers
